name: What utility connections are needed for a tiny home used as a primary residence?

mainEntity.name: What utility connections are needed for a tiny home used as a primary residence?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tiny home used as a primary residence typically requires standard utility connections for water, electricity, and sewage. This involves connecting to municipal services or setting up independent systems. Water can come from a city line or a well, while electricity can be from the grid or an off-grid solar setup. Waste disposal usually involves connecting to a city sewer system or a septic tank. Propane or natural gas lines may also be installed for heating and cooking. Proper planning for these connections is critical during the design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tiny homes for primary residence need water, electricity, and sewage connections, either from municipal services or independent off-grid systems like solar and septic.
